content: Cross-checked across 2 independent blog posts (Mr Latte, Tim Cappalli/Timbits) circa Feb 2026: using WebAuthn PRF to derive data-encryption keys is dangerous because OS credential managers (Apple Passwords, Google Password Manager) give no warning that deleting a passkey destroys derived encryption keys permanently. Both authors explicitly carve out an exception for password-manager vault unlock IF the vault has independent recovery (master password / recovery key / social recovery) as a fallback - i.e. PRF must never be the sole key-wrapping path.
